column1: Adjusted assessment: The FOMC statement is mildly positive—solid growth, easing inflation, and risks moving toward better balance, with policy on hold and QT continuing. The latest Beige Book references across Districts (e.g., Boston highlights of moderating wages; New York regional activity little changed; Philadelphia nonmanufacturing softer; Cleveland manufacturers mixed/weak) point to only slight-to-modest growth, cooler labor demand, continued CRE strain, and tight credit conditions. These anecdotes temper the “solid pace” framing, indicating a more mixed backdrop even as price and wage pressures continue to ease. Net: cautiously positive, but more constrained by sectoral soft spots and credit conditions than the statement alone implies. sentiment score = 0.18
